definition: One concept with the same meaning in every parliament; representable consistently (values may live in metadata in some bodies and only in documents in others).

The concept is shared, but one source label covers several roles that must be kept apart to compare parliaments (e.g. 'answer date' = decided / dispatched / registered; type labels like 'Antrag' that map to several harmonised types).
No common meaning across parliaments (e.g. oral answers in question time, executive-own business filed as affairs); representable only with the body's own vocabulary.
